name: loadState
label: Load state
description: Specify if either of the feedback buttons is pre selected on load

name: positiveFeedback
label: Positive feedback

heading.description: Allows user to configure the header shown in the popover

name: negativeFeedback
label: Negative feedback

heading.description: Allows user to configure the header shown in the popover

items.description: Array of objects providing configuration for sections within the granular feedback popover.

name: manageSubmit
label: Manage submit
description: Override the default functionality of submit button. If true, after user clicks on the Submit button, the button grays out for BU to update error property to show a error message or close popover

name: error
label: Error
description: Allows user to handle the closing of granular feedback once user clicks on 'Submit'
